text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Chamber of Commerce calls for clear direction for the country. Chamber President J.R Darmanin says the new government needs to give more information on how it intends to implement its mandate.
- Finance Minister Lino Spiteri says the government and opposition are set to cooperate on ensuring the continued growth of the financial sector.

- Opposition leader Eddie Fenech Adami calls for government clarity to avoid employment disaster. Speaking in parliament he said the government had not spelt out its employment policies. Indications it would curtail some major projects could lead to unemployment.
